title: The Skipped Beat: A Study of Sociopragmatic Understanding in LLMs for 64 Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing the zero-shot, few-shot, and fine-tuned classification performance of various Large Language Models (LLMs) on sociopragmatic meaning tasks (such as hate speech detection, sentiment analysis, and emotion recognition) across 64 different languages to identify performance disparities, particularly between high-resource (English/Western) languages and low-resource or non-Latin script languages.
